arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original DEADWALL source-art sprite, one complete isolated Tonneau fermé à disque métallique — variante 1.
INPUTS: Image 1 is the AUTHORITATIVE geometry, arrangement and variant palette, rendered through the unchanged public structural205 game painter on the same authored instance as Art238, painter variant 1. Image 2 is the accepted Art238 variant0, MATERIAL FINISH AND PAINTERLY QUALITY ONLY. Do not copy variant0 parts, roof seams, bands or construction when they differ from image 1. These are already-defined painter variants of an existing object, not new runtime objects.
VIEW: strict orthographic overhead plan, camera looking vertically down. Source X goes right and source Y goes down; keep image 1 orientation, aspect ratio, silhouette, number of parts and their relative positions. Do not tilt the camera or expose a tall facade.
SUBJECT AND PARTS: One compact closed rain barrel viewed exactly from above. Preserve the muted blue-grey outer metal rim, dark annular inset, pale beige inner ring, and the smaller CENTRAL circular metal plate with its dark outline. Across the central plate is ONE short pale HORIZONTAL handle/strap at the exact canonical location. Preserve the TWO small dark fasteners at left and right of the plate, and the short dull rust-coloured outlet at lower right. Do not transfer the two broad transverse bands or single upper-right bung from v0. No open blue water surface, bucket, downpipe, extended faucet, flow, splash, active service or fill-level indicator.
AUTHOR-DESIGN ENVELOPE: 0.7 m across X by 0.7 m along Y, separate authored height 1 m. These dimensions describe the existing fixture, not a manufacturer specification. The source layout remains EXT-MONDE-T045-V01; this plan number is independent of painter variant 1.
MATERIALS: serious grounded post-apocalyptic game art, restrained detailed hand-painted pre-rendered treatment matching image 2, but material assignment and muted colours from image 1. Fine weathered grain, dull metal, modest scuffs or oxidation, soft neutral overhead illumination. Readable primary shapes; idle and unattended. No invented severe destruction or decoration.
OUTPUT: ONE whole object only, true transparent RGBA background. Centre the complete silhouette with at least 12 percent transparent margin on all sides. Do not crop thin components. No ground plane, external cast shadow, landscape, scene, border, grid, lettering, labels, dimensions, logo, UI or watermark. No extra detached tools, people, animals or active effects. Preserve native generated output; this is a source-art proposal for later calibration, not pixel-for-pixel or metric 1:1 certification.
